implementation: TuxCare Kernel Crypto API (HMAC DRBG Conditioning Component)
description: The Linux kernel crypto API implementation provides cryptographic services to Linux kernel space software components and user space via the AF_ALG interface. The following cipher implementation is covered: Generic C non-optimized HMAC DRBG Conditioning Component implementation.
